before: 1..3 includes the endpoint 3. 1...3 excludes the endpoint 3. The extra dot changes the boundary rule.
to_a collects this small integer range into an Array. Do not materialize an unbounded or enormous range just to inspect it.
join(",") makes one string containing the entries separated by commas. It does not change the original numeric values.

Complete local Ruby example; the app itself does not execute it:
```ruby
puts (1..3).to_a.join(",")
```
Expected output or behavior: 1,2,3. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
